expected_behavior: The answer names one entry skill for the user's situation and says why it fits, instead of listing every skill.
Work that must stop before it is finished is routed to o-brief for a handoff note.
A question the plan cannot settle is routed to o-sketch for a prototype or to o-analyze for evidence; a design question the conversation cannot settle goes to o-interview.
The guide names the skill and stops; it does not start running it unless the user asks.
